chunks: The one who sleeps in Makkah is like one who spends the night in worship in other lands.

key_terms.النَّائِمُ: the one who sleeps or rests
key_terms.كَالْمُتَهَجِّدِ: like one engaged in night worship

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of staying or sleeping in Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the special sanctity and merit of Makkah. It teaches that even resting there carries a spiritual value comparable to night worship elsewhere, emphasizing the distinction of sacred places in Islam.
